title: Line-art multi-panel storyboard
technique: One line-art sheet of 12 panels sets the shot order; words add faces, voices, light.
story: At night a shopper almost buys the Fig & Cedar candle.
She wonders if it's safe for her cat; the page never says.
So she gives up. Guess not.
Next day the owner sees three sales this month and decides to discontinue it.
Scout's orb pops in: Don't guess. Ask them. She was one answer away.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.

shots.what: Her hand on the mouse by her candle; product page on screen.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: The cursor glides to Add to cart; cat on the sofa back.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Her eyes go from the cat to her small candle.
shots.line: Wait. Is it safe for my cat?
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Over her shoulder, she scrolls the page: no pet information.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Close on her face, lips closed, a small sigh.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: She shuts the laptop; camera flips overhead into the owner's studio.
Chin on her hand at the table, reading her sales screen.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: She lifts the lit Fig & Cedar jar in both hands.
shots.line: I really thought Fig and Cedar would sell.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: She holds the jar over an open kraft mailer box.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Scout's orb pops in by her shoulder; she turns to it.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Back to that night: laptop closed, cat asleep by her candle.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: The orb becomes the o of the Scout end screen.
